signup.title: Sign up
signup.subtitle: Enter your email — we'll send a code to confirm registration.

terms.before: By creating an account, you agree to the
terms.after: . We'll occasionally send you account-related emails.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Enter your email or phone — we'll send the authorization code to your email.

signinRecovery.title: Recovery sign-in
signinRecovery.enterLogin: Enter the email or phone linked to your account.
signinRecovery.twoFaOnly: Requires 2FA to be on: your password or authenticator code, plus a recovery code.
signinRecovery.emailSigninLink: Back to the main sign-in method

confirm.title: Confirmation

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email. Enter it to continue.
hint.PHONE: We sent a code to your phone. Enter it to continue.
hint.TOTP: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
hint.RECOVERY: Enter one of your single-use recovery codes.

confirm.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but signing in failed. No need to confirm again — just try once more.
confirm.lastResend: Note: that was the last resend of the code.
confirm.exhaustedAttempts: Wrong code, no attempts left. Request a new code.
confirm.exhaustedExpired: The code has expired. Request a new code.
confirm.deadEnd: You've run out of entry attempts and resends. Start signing in again.
confirm.deadEndNoResend: You've run out of entry attempts. Start signing in again.
confirm.deadEndExpired: The time to confirm has run out and there are no resends left. Start signing in again.
confirm.deadEndExpiredNoResend: The time to confirm has run out. Start signing in again.
confirm.invalidated: This operation can no longer be completed. Start signing in again.

password.title: Set a password

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — it confirms that you are the one setting the password.

password.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the password setup with. Start it again from the settings.
password.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but 2FA could not be turned on. No need to confirm again — just retry.
password.invalidated: This password setup can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

totp.title: Connect the app

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — it confirms that you are the one connecting the app.

totp.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm connecting the app with. Start it again from the settings.
totp.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but the app connection screen could not be opened. No need to confirm again — just retry.
totp.invalidated: Connecting the app can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

recoveryCodes.title: Reissue recovery codes

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — it confirms that you are the one reissuing the recovery codes.
hint.PASSWORD: Enter your 2FA password. Since the whole set of codes is being replaced, a recovery code cannot be used here.
hint.TOTP: Enter the 2FA code from your authenticator app. Since the whole set of codes is being replaced, a recovery code cannot be used here.

recoveryCodes.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the reissue with. Start it again from the settings.
recoveryCodes.awaitingFinish: The confirmation was accepted, but the codes could not be issued. No need to confirm again — just retry.
recoveryCodes.invalidated: This reissue can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

disable2fa.title: Turn 2FA off

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — it confirms that you are the one turning 2FA off. If you have lost access to your email, change your email in the settings first.
hint.PASSWORD: Enter your 2FA password — or switch and enter one of your recovery codes.
hint.TOTP: Enter the 2FA code from your authenticator app — or switch and enter one of your recovery codes.
hint.RECOVERY: Enter one of your single-use recovery codes.

disable2fa.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm turning 2FA off. Start it again from the settings.
disable2fa.awaitingFinish: The confirmation was accepted, but 2FA could not be turned off. No need to confirm again — just retry.
disable2fa.invalidated: Turning 2FA off can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

email.title: Change email

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your current email — it confirms that you are the one changing it.
hint.PASSWORD: Enter your 2FA password — it confirms the email change in addition to the code we sent.
hint.TOTP: Enter the 2FA code from your authenticator app — it confirms the email change in addition to the code we sent.

email.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the email change. Start it again from the settings.
email.awaitingFinish: The confirmation was accepted, but the code could not be sent to the new email. No need to confirm again — just retry.
email.invalidated: This email change can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

emailRecovery.title: Change email

hint.PASSWORD: Enter your 2FA password. Nothing was sent to your current email — a recovery code comes next.
hint.TOTP: Enter the 2FA code from your authenticator app. Nothing was sent to your current email — a recovery code comes next.
hint.RECOVERY: Enter one of your single-use recovery codes — it replaces the code from your current email.

emailRecovery.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the email change. Start it again from the settings.
emailRecovery.awaitingFinish: The confirmation was accepted, but the code could not be sent to the new email. No need to confirm again — just retry.
emailRecovery.invalidated: This email change can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

emailConfirm.title: Change email

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to the new email {{value}}. Once you enter it, the address changes.

emailConfirm.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the new email. Start the change again from the settings.
emailConfirm.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but the email could not be changed. No need to confirm again — just retry.
emailConfirm.invalidated: This email change can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

phone.title: Phone number

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — it confirms that you are the one setting the number {{value}}.
hint.PASSWORD: Enter your 2FA password — it confirms the phone change in addition to the code we sent.
hint.TOTP: Enter the 2FA code from your authenticator app — it confirms the phone change in addition to the code we sent.

phone.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the number. Start again from the settings.
phone.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but the number could not be saved. No need to confirm again — just retry.
phone.invalidated: This number can no longer be saved. Start again from the settings.

password.title: Set a password
password.lead: After each emailed code — when you sign in to your account or confirm an operation — you will also be asked for this password.
password.copyFailed: Could not copy the password — save it by hand.
password.generateFailed: Could not generate a password — try again or come up with your own.
password.conflict: 2FA is already on — a new password can only be set after turning it off.

totp.title: Connect the app
totp.intro: After each emailed code — when you sign in to your account or confirm an operation — you will also be asked for a code from the app.
totp.lead: Scan the code with an authenticator app (for example, Google Authenticator) — or enter the secret by hand if scanning is not possible.
totp.qrAlt: QR code with the authenticator secret
totp.qrFailed: The QR code did not load — add the authenticator by hand
totp.secretReveal: Show the secret for manual entry
totp.copyFailed: Could not copy the secret — write it down by hand.
totp.codeLead: Enter the code your app shows: that is how we make sure the authenticator was added correctly.
totp.gone: This setup can no longer be completed: the authenticator blank only worked inside the operation, and that operation is gone. Start connecting again.
totp.conflict: Two-factor protection is already on — the app can only be connected after turning it off.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.warning: Save the codes now: we will not show them again, and reloading the page loses them.
codes.lead: Each code works once. Use it instead of your password or authenticator code when they are unavailable or lost.
codes.leadReissued: The set has been reissued — the old codes no longer work. Each code works once and is used instead of your password or authenticator code when they are unavailable or lost.
codes.doneHint: The button turns on once the codes are copied or downloaded.
codes.copyFailed: Could not copy the codes — save them by hand or download the file.
codes.downloadFailed: Could not download the file — copy the codes or save them by hand.
codes.goneOnce: Recovery codes are shown once, and that showing is already closed — not even we can restore the list.
codes.goneReissue: If you did not save them, reissue the set: the old codes stop working and you get a new one.
codes.goneNo2fa: Recovery codes come with 2FA, and yours is off — there is nothing to reissue. Turn 2FA on, and a new set is issued with it.

profile.title: User profile
profile.recoveryCodesEmpty: No recovery codes left — reissue them
profile.recoveryCodesLast: One recovery code left — reissue now
profile.tzUnsupported: your browser does not know this zone, dates are shown in the device time zone

NONE.title: Account is not protected by 2FA
NONE.hint: Signing in to your account is confirmed only by the authorization code we send to your email

PASSWORD.title: Sign-in is confirmed by a password
PASSWORD.hint: An authenticator app is stronger — its code changes every 30 seconds

TOTP.title: Account is protected by 2FA
TOTP.hint: Sign-in is confirmed by an authenticator app

settings.title: Account settings
settings.langHint: Language of emails and server messages. The interface language is switched in the header.
settings.osZoneHint: Your zone is {{zone}}; it is not in the list. Pick “Auto” and the server will choose the closest one.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Information shown may differ from them for a while — to apply them instantly, sign in again.
settings.substituted: The closest available zone was saved: {{zone}} — its time differs from yours.

email.title: Email
email.sub: Serves as your login; authorization and operation confirmation codes arrive here, as do important service notices
email.hint: The confirmation code will be sent to your current email — {{email}}
email.noAccess: No access to your current email?
email.hasAccess: I can access my current email
email.recoveryTitle: Change without a message to your current email
email.recoveryText: Confirm it with your 2FA password or authenticator code and one recovery code.
email.recoveryHint: Nothing is sent to your current email; the new one gets a code at the end
email.pending: To make the change take effect, enter the confirmation code sent to {{email}}.
email.pendingWhen: Confirm before {{date}}. Until then, and after the deadline passes, your current email is still used for signing in and for notifications.
email.pendingConfirmedWhen: Finish before {{date}}. Until then, and after the deadline passes, your current email is still used for signing in and for notifications.
email.pendingConfirmed: The code was accepted — finish the change to {{email}}.

phone.title: Phone
phone.sub: Serves as an additional login for signing in to your account, while authorization codes keep going to your email; the phone can also make recovering access to your account through support easier
phone.hint: The confirmation code will be sent to your email — {{email}}, not to the phone

twoFa.title: Two-factor protection

lead.NONE: Signing in to your account is confirmed only by the authorization code we send to your email. 2FA adds one more step to it and to confirming operations — a password or a code from an app.
lead.PASSWORD: Sign-ins to your account and operations are confirmed by the authorization code and your password.
lead.TOTP: Sign-ins to your account and operations are confirmed by the authorization code and a code from your authenticator app.

password.name: Password
password.how: A secret you set yourself and type at each confirmation
password.plus: Nothing to install: works on any device
password.minus: Never changes — once leaked, 2FA stops protecting

totp.name: Authenticator app
totp.how: An app on your phone shows a code that changes every 30 seconds
totp.plus: The code lives on your device only and burns out fast
totp.minus: Needs a phone with the app

twoFa.codesPromise: Turning 2FA on issues recovery codes — a spare way in if the password or the phone is lost. They are shown exactly once.
twoFa.changeHint: Changing the 2FA method — switching to the other one or setting a new password — is only possible after turning 2FA off. Turning it off is confirmed by the code we send and your 2FA password or authenticator code (or a recovery code), and the next time you turn it on you get new recovery codes.
